methods.what: Surface integral of the potential over a sphere of radius R, combining a constant interior term and a contribution from an enclosed mass M (Gauss mean-value property of the potential)
methods.quote:
$\int V ds = [-4\pi \frac{RR}{?} A + \frac{4\pi M}{R}-]$[?]
$= 4\pi RRA + 4\pi RM$

methods.what: Interchanging the order of integration: the potential integrated over the surface computed by integrating 1/r over the sphere for each mass element, giving 4πRR/ρ per mass element
